text:
Aisha: Hey all, day 2 here. Trying to follow the Mac M2 bootstrap but running into weird failures installing node and ruby with asdf. Node build fails saying missing `libssl` and ruby build says `readline` missing. I have both brew and nix installed, not sure if that conflicts. Anyone run into this combo?

Mateo: Welcome! :wave: Mixing Homebrew and Nix can be fine but the PATH/order matters. What error exactly for node? Also which asdf plugins (nodejs, ruby)?

Aisha: Using `asdf plugin-add nodejs` + `asdf install nodejs 18.18.0` -> gyp/compile gives `ld: library not found for -lssl` at link time. For ruby `asdf install ruby 3.2.2` -> `mkmf.rb couldn't find header for readline`

Infra: Two quick checks: 1) Confirm `/opt/homebrew/bin` is first in PATH. 2) Check which openssl and readline Homebrew installed: `brew info openssl@3` and `brew info readline`. On Apple Silicon the keg-only formulae require you to pass flags.

Mateo: For nodejs specifically, the asdf nodejs plugin uses `node-build` which relies on system libs. Try:```bash
brew install openssl@1.1 readline
export LDFLAGS="-L/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/lib -L/opt/homebrew/opt/readline/lib"
export CPPFLAGS="-I/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/include -I/opt/homebrew/opt/readline/include"
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/lib/pkgconfig:/opt/homebrew/opt/readline/lib/pkgconfig"
asdf install nodejs 18.18.0
```\nAnd for node you often need to import the GPG keys used by the plugin: `bash ~/.asdf/plugins/nodejs/bin/import-release-team-keyring`

Aisha: I had openssl@3 installed via brew earlier. Switched to openssl@1.1 and exported the flags. Node build went through but yarn installs fail with `npm ERR! code ERR_OSSL_EVP_UNSUPPORTED` when running certain dev scripts.

Mateo: That error is OpenSSL 3 being incompatible with some Node native deps. Using openssl@1.1 for the build helps but runtime still picks up openssl@3 from PATH or from system. Confirm `otool -L $(which node)` or `node -p "process.versions.openssl"` to see what node links against. If mismatch, try reinstalling node with `brew link --force openssl@1.1` (careful) or use `NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider` as a temporary workaround for old packages.

Aisha: Ruby still failing even after installing readline. Build log shows it tries to use `/nix/store/.../include` headers (from Nix) and then fails at linking. Could Nix be interfering?

Infra: Yes, if NIX_PROFILES or PATH includes Nix's profile directories earlier, build scripts will pick up Nix headers. You can sandbox the asdf build by invoking with a clean env:```bash
env -i PATH="$PATH" LDFLAGS="$LDFLAGS" CPPFLAGS="$CPPFLAGS" asdf install ruby 3.2.2
```\nBut easier: temporarily `export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"` in that terminal and retry.

Aisha: Doing the PATH swap fixed ruby build. I also had to `gem update --system` afterwards. Two more quick Qs: 1) my fish shell doesn't source direnv hooks (I use fish by default). 2) docker complains `permission denied` when trying `docker build` after installing Docker Desktop.

Mateo: For fish + direnv, add `eval (direnv hook fish)` to `~/.config/fish/config.fish`. For asdf, make sure `asdf` init is in your fish config too: `source (asdf where)/asdf.fish` or add the recommended snippet from our devex docs.

Infra: Docker permission: On mac, Docker Desktop handles sockets but if you run docker via multipass or a rootful helper you might need to add your user to the docker group (Linux). On mac, check Docker Desktop settings -> Resources -> File Sharing if build context can't read files. Also try `docker run hello-world` to confirm daemon. If you see `permission denied` on `/var/run/docker.sock`, restart Docker Desktop and ensure no leftover symlink points to a root-owned socket.

Aisha: Thanks, `docker run hello-world` works after a restart. Fish + direnv needed that hook line. I also lost git signing with GPG after switching shells 1 How to restore commit signing?

Mateo: Ensure gpg-agent is running and your `GPG_TTY` is set for interactive shells. For fish add:```fish
set -x GPG_TTY (tty)
gpg-connect-agent updatestartuptty /bye >/dev/null 2>&1
```\nIf you're using 1Password for SSH/GPG agent, confirm the 1password-cli is unlocked: `op signin` and `op item get <ssh-key>` if you store keys there.

Aisha: Final piece 1 dotfiles: my dotfiles repo has a `bootstrap.sh` but no explicit `SETUP.md`. Anyone review small PRs for dotfiles in infra standards?

Infra: We have a `dotfiles-template` in the onboarding org. PRs to `dotfiles` are welcomed; ping `#devex` or open a tiny PR and tag `@mateo` or `@infra` for quick review. Also add exact brew formulas and environment vars, plus any fish vs zsh notes.

Aisha: Great — I added `SETUP.md` with brew list, asdf plugin versions, and a note about Nix interfering with builds. Reinstalled node and ruby cleanly, yarn scripts work with `NODE_OPTIONS` removed. Thanks for the quick help! :tada:

Devex Bot: Nice work! If you want the canonical checklist, see https://redwood.ai/devex/checklist. Tip: commit `asdf/.tool-versions` to dotfiles to lock runtime versions. If you need laptop special image (VPN/corp certs) DM `@infra`.
